title: Efficient water electrolysis with Ce-WO3@NiCo bifunctional catalysts
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,13529-13539
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09712F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Yuan Qin, Meng Ding, Weixiao Ji, Yafang Zhang, Gang Zhao
A novel and efficient Ce-WO3@NiCo bifunctional electrocatalyst is fabricated, exhibiting outstanding HER and OER performance. The two-electrode cell integrated by Ce-WO3@NiCo requires only 1.624 V at 10 mA cm−2 and displays long-term stability.
